status_detail: City of Quincy issued an Optional Determination of Nonsignificance/Notice of Application for MWH08 on 2024-08-19; Ecology PARIS shows active Construction Stormwater General Permit coverage WAR313961 version 2 effective 2026-01-01 through 2030-12-31. Active stormwater coverage authorizes construction stormwater discharges but is not independent proof of energized capacity or full buildout.

actions.description: Microsoft Corporation application date listed in City of Quincy ODNS/NOA for MWH08 Data Center.

ODNS/NOA for a 455,000-square-foot, two-story industrial data center on the existing Microsoft MWH campus, with backup-power generator facilities, parking, fuel storage, and infrastructure improvements.
Initial Construction Stormwater General Permit coverage WAR313961 shown in PARIS for MWH08.
